{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yeah, I signed the papers yesterday. It's finally over."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Wow, only three days left."}, {"id": 2, "text": "I knowㅠㅠ There's so much to do"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Did you call a packing service?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "No haha, semi-packing. I have to pack the stuff for the move on Saturday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "After the move, take Sunday off to rest. I miss Bori too haha. Want to grab brunch?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Sounds good! Hyejin unnie is coming to help with the unpacking on Sunday."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh, that's great. So Bori will be home that day too?"}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Yeah, oppa is bringing her on Sunday morning."}, {"id":1, "text": "That's a relief. Should I call Subin too? ◆"}, {"id":2, "text": "I asked, but Subin can't come on Sunday. She said she has a prior engagement."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "That's a shame. Oh, how should I write the new hire Chaeyul's English name? I need to send a calendar invite."}, {"id": 1, "text": "He said to write it as Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' haha."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Okay. What about the sofa? Bori always slept there."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I posted it on Carrot Market and someone contacted me right away. We decided to meet in person tomorrow evening."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Wow, that's fast. Let's have Chae-yul do it haha"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I know. They said they'll return the deposit right after the inspection."}, {"id": 1, "text": "My older brother used to work at a moving company. Should I ask him for some know-how?"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Oh, really? Does he still work there?"}]}
